prerequisites: To enroll in this course, it is necessary to have passed or be enrolled in all subjects from courses lower than the one in which this subject is located.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basis for activities related to Production Organization and Management.
Understand the scope of different production-related activities.
Acquire a comprehensive vision for the execution of activities related to production organization and management.
Perform a job evaluation from an approach that helps the development of people with a perspective of efficiency and equality.

assessment_rules: Unethical behavior (copying, plagiarism, unauthorized electronic devices) will result in a 0.0 grade and failure of the course. For continuous assessment, mandatory practice attendance and submissions are required (maximum 2 justified absences with recovery work). All assessment components (two theory-practical exams, one practice exercise) must be passed or achieve an average pass, with no individual component score below 4 out of 10 for compensation. Global assessment consists of a 60% theory-practical part and a 40% practice exercise part, with variations depending on prior practice completion. To pass the course, all parts must be passed, or the overall average must be passing and no individual part score lower than 4; otherwise, the final grade will be a fail (recorded as 4.0).
